41: ## Fork recovery
42: 
43: A real fork records exact ordered detach and attach steps and copies to one staging
44: slot. Each delta and cursor advancement commits together. Check expected old values,
45: recompute target root, then atomically publish tip/generation/slot/events and retire old
46: physical slots. Existing readers retain their SQLite snapshots. The eight original
47: cuts remain: intent; two detach cuts; three attach cuts; before-publish; published.
48: No partially changed state is published as a coherent root.
49: 
50: `recover` first completes the exact existing intent, then inspects the indexed set of
51: fully verified stored tips. A strictly heavier tip is activated even if a process died
52: between `admit` and `activate`. Equal work leaves the current tip unchanged. A peer's
53: claimed work total never becomes an indexed authoritative block record.
54: 
55: ## Beyond4096 and bounded cache retention

193: this includes an admission committed before its activation intent. Equal work retains
194: the current chain. Corrupt generation, steps, root or delta preconditions remain fenced.
195: 
196: Reconstruction spools ancestor identities on disk and checks snapshots/deltas/roots;
197: retention is not a finality threshold. Full maps/root computations and long history
198: remain resource costs. No Hepta operation journal, provider effect or user database is
199: inside this chain namespace or its undo transaction.
200: 
201: ### Metadata-only native ancestry access
202: 
203: The existing native owner now separates metadata retrieval from full packet retrieval.
204: Ancestry/DAA/current-clock traversal uses block-ID-bound header projections, while work
205: admission and queried transaction inclusion still check complete packets. No stored
206: schema, genesis, reward, rollback or root rule changes. This removes repeated Rust-side
207: packet materialization but does not turn the complete-state root into persistent
208: incremental authenticated storage or qualify physical power loss.
